title: A bill to amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to allow permanent look-through treatment of payments between related foreign corporations.

actions.text: Sponsor introductory remarks on measure. (CR S5507-5508)
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Finance.

latest_action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Finance.

summaries.text: Amends the Internal Revenue Code to make permanent the tax rule exempting dividends, interest, rents, and royalties received or accrued from certain controlled foreign corporations by a related entity from treatment as foreign holding company income (thus permitting tax deferral of such income).

sources.label: CRS summary (Introduced in Senate)

related.title: To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to extend the look-through treatment of payments between related controlled foreign corporations.
